simple.meaning: מְשִׁסָּה (mᵉshiççâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “plunder.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 21:14. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְשִׁסָּה (H4933) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מְשִׁסָּה (mᵉshiççâh) / H4933 is traced through 2 Kings 21:14, Isaiah 42:22, Isaiah 42:24, Jeremiah 30:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

timeline.evidenceText: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,
But this is a robbed and plundered people.
Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured.
Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.
